compiler.arguments: [--bundle ROOT] source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]
compiler.profile_selection: Books containing a loader-installed primitive type select knot-literals-wasm-1; other books retain knot-enum-1.

evaluator.budget_unit: one explicit source-machine step; a terminal return consumes no further budget; primitive decoding and application have separate fixed bounds

wasm.parameters: live enum ordinals only; erased parameters omitted
wasm.empty_matches: i32.const 0 in a region with no domain-valid execution; remains inside the eight-instruction knot-enum-1 whitelist

output_policy: The compiler opens the requested output only after complete checking and bounded emission; semantic failure and exhaustion leave existing output untouched. File-write failures are HostFailure and may leave an incomplete file, never a Built result. Callers must use the exit status, not file presence, as evidence of a fresh artifact.
external_argument_domain: Each live evaluator ordinal must designate a nullary constructor of its declared type; eval-cli reports HostFailure structured-argument for fielded constructor ordinals. The Node adapter accepts only enum-signatured host calls: live arity and profile-wide 0..255 are checked, while declared signature and per-type domain remain caller preconditions.
later_milestones: broader recursion beyond first-parameter field descent

structural_recursion.rule: First checked self-call argument must be a Reference to a strict field descendant of parameter 0, or a rebuilt Value/Construct that denotes one (its refinement unfolded layer by layer: same types, tags and field levels in order); matches propagate descendant levels.
structural_recursion.contract_note: This rule supersedes two sentences of tests/compiler-recursion/SPEC.md: that reconstructed constructors do not satisfy the rule, and that reconstruction of a strict descendant does not qualify once its checked term is no longer a Reference. Since nest round 4 (3a35051) a rebuilt Value/Construct that denotes a strict descendant qualifies; rebuilt parents and rebuilt non-descendants still report Unsupported check recursive-call. The recursion SPEC belongs to another increment and is unamended here; the amendment is left to the coordinator and the campaign/descent-2 integration.
structural_recursion.forward_and_mutual_calls: Unchanged; live forward calls are Invalid check forward-live-call.

structural_terms.patterns: ordered binary first-match matrices over multiple scrutinees, wildcard/variable rows and nested constructors; optional comma separators; plain/+ binders share lexical identities; _ is anonymous; all-variable columns on the latest let binder alias without inspection; erased fields stay erased
structural_terms.observation: Live-field projection, declaration order; erased fields omitted

fields_wasm.arguments: source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]
fields_wasm.budgets: Same defaults and maximum overrides as compiler; profile selection is explicit.
fields_wasm.enum_entry_unchanged: Books without installed primitive types retain Enum{} and its unchanged capability rejection; primitive books select the separate literals profile.
fields_wasm.enum_only_book_bytes: Identical to knot-enum-1; 25 frozen module hashes checked in both compiler lanes.

representation.fielded_type: i32 address of [tag][live fields in declaration order], one 4-byte word each
representation.zero_address: Valid cell address, not a null sentinel

arena.guard: unsigned size > 65536 - bump; the only unreachable in the profile
arena.allocation: Arguments saved before allocation; stores after bounded pointer advance
arena.lifetime: Instance lifetime; immutable initialized cells; no free, reset, growth or reclamation

fields_wasm.exports: All original functions, unchanged indices; allocator appended and unexported; no memory or global exports.
fields_wasm.host_precondition: Checked Knot module of selected profile; invoke only enum-only live parameter/result signatures with valid per-type ordinals. Structured functions are for compiled callers. Adapter cannot enforce signature provenance.

host_outcomes.node_startup_failure: Outside adapter classification; not a successful execution

fields_wasm.recursion: first-parameter structural descent, including nested pattern fields
fields_wasm.proof_boundary: Five checked capability/representation/erasure helper laws, not general compiler or memory refinement.
fields_wasm.empty_matches: i32.const 0; no domain-valid execution reaches the empty branch

pattern_matrix.lowering_law: src/lowering-LAWS.bend::irrefutable_first_row_selected, filled in src/lowering-PROOF.bend and imported by the matrix proof entry
pattern_matrix.core: Binary Decision with live Remainder scopes, checked then coalesced into exhaustive core Case; Matrix, Decision, Remainder and Alias never enter runtime core
pattern_matrix.bounds: 4096 residual-matrix visits per expanded source match, including leaves and empty remainders; Expansion threads the unused total through both branches without division. Each separately reached source match starts a new budget; checker/expansion depth and lexical-level limits remain.
unmet: rec-swapped-args: Unsupported check recursive-call, frozen Invalid expectation unchanged
rec-alias: Unsupported check recursive-call, frozen Invalid expectation unchanged
General law: every exhaustive matrix lowers without a missing branch (only helper laws and exhaustive_matrix_witness are proved; open obligation, D21)

General law in its total form: a matrix whose first row is irrefutable lowers to that row's body (only its partial-correctness part is proved; open obligation, D21). The total form is false at the fixed 4096-visit quota: the frozen control tests/compiler-nest/controls/matrix-work.bend (13 columns, first row all _, body On{}; the seed prints On{}) reports Exhausted check budget, because column_step splits on any constructor head even when the first row is irrefutable (T(n+1)=2+2T(n), 24,574 visits). It is dischargeable only relative to sufficient work, or once expansion stops splitting a matrix whose first row is irrefutable, a change to that frozen control that needs coordinator review
pattern_matrix.defaults: The negative branch excludes one constructor and retains the live unrefined lexical binding. A variable row is checked even when its remainder is empty. A missing arm is dead code only when a live binder outside the pending suffix of the match frontier (which starts at the scrutinee) has an empty constructor set: an emptied residual or a zero-constructor datatype. Dead code never bypasses body checking.
pattern_matrix.names: Names are words joined by dots (Invalid lex name otherwise). A dotted pattern or live let binder repeats a parameter of the same function and is otherwise Invalid parse pattern-binder or binding-name, and an erased let's name is a name however it is spelled (src/LAWS.bend::dotted_binder_needs_a_parameter, dotted_binder_repeats_a_parameter, dotted_reference_binds_nothing, erased_dotted_let_binds_a_name, live_dotted_let_needs_a_parameter, unnamed_binder_is_invalid). Match and case headers join lines up to their colon. A constructor's { must touch its name in patterns and bodies (Invalid parse detached-brace otherwise); joined header tokens keep their offsets, so a line break never bridges that gap.
pattern_matrix.unsupported: A new source match on a residual binding reports Unsupported check default-scrutinee until source-level residual constructor sets are carried through nested matches. A second case arm on an arm's line reports Unsupported parse same-line-arm; the seed accepts it, and it refines a former Invalid parse outcome (src/LAWS.bend::same_line_arm, body_ends_at_line_break). Arguments separated by whitespace alone (`two(a b)`, `Pr{a b}`; a name, or in a pattern a marking `+`, after an argument) report Unsupported parse argument-whitespace, a spaced `+` after an argument in a body operator (the seed reads `a ++ b` as a concatenation), a promotion of a promotion (`++y`, `+ +y`, `++u = x`) repeated-promotion, and a line break in a let before its `=` or between its marker and its name line-break; the seed accepts them all (src/LAWS.bend::spaced_plus_after_argument). Line breaks around the items of a list, after `case`, `match` and a let's `=`, and arm bodies at any column follow the seed (src/LAWS.bend::list_across_lines, arm_across_lines, cases_right_of_parent); an arm body that starts with `case` or `def` at or below its case's column reports Invalid parse body-indentation (src/LAWS.bend::keyword_is_no_arm_body). An unindented def body (the frontend gate pins it Invalid, though the seed accepts it) and an untyped let split before its `=` (top-level-indentation) keep open D4 gaps. A literal in a row of several columns reports Unsupported check literal-column.
pattern_matrix.promotion: A + row makes a lambda-case binder (a parameter or field) reusable with every alias of its level; a let binder and its aliases keep the let's declared quantity under any row (src/matrix-LAWS.bend::parameter_alias_promotes, let_alias_keeps_quantity). A + mark may raise a frontier binder past its type's kind; as in the seed, the kind is judged only where the match frontier binds the binder: leaving it undestructured, ahead of a later matched binder (flat match, matrix split or zero-row match) or at a body that is not a match, a let included (src/patterns.bend::advance and close; src/matrix-LAWS.bend::destructured_promotion_is_unbound, later_match_binds_promotion, leaf_binds_promotion). A promoted Type-kind binder destructured first is never bound; its fields carry the promoted quantity.
pattern_matrix.let_inference: An unannotated let infers its value, and a checked Value or Construct term has no inferred type: a binder that a positive branch refined to a constructor, flat or in a matrix, through an alias, a nested field level or an enclosing match, needs an annotation (Invalid check annotation-required, as a literal constructor does). A residual or default-row binder, a field never split, a later parameter, a call and an annotated let stay inferable (src/check.bend::expected; src/check-LAWS.bend::refined_value_needs_annotation, refined_construct_needs_annotation, unrefined_binder_is_inferable, annotation_admits_constructor; src/matrix-LAWS.bend::refined_flat_let_witness, refined_matrix_let_witness, residual_let_witness, annotated_let_witness).
pattern_matrix.glue: The seed reads `+` and `-` as a marker only where a name follows directly, and a return arrow as the literal `->` (src/syntax.bend::marks; src/parse.bend::promotes). After a term in a pattern row a `+` that does not touch its binder ends the row (Invalid parse expected-:), so `a + b` is rejected while `a +b`, a promotion that starts a row or follows a comma, and one inside fields stay accepted. After a let, a marker apart from its name is Invalid parse detached-marker; first in a body, and in a parameter list, it may be spaced (src/LAWS.bend::marks_witness, detached_plus, detached_marker, first_marker). A split arrow is Invalid parse function-result (src/LAWS.bend::split_arrow).
open_obligations: Irrefutable first row (D21): unproved general law in its total form, which includes that the lowering succeeds; the partial-correctness part is proved by src/lowering-LAWS.bend::irrefutable_first_row_selected; witnessed by irrefutable_lowering_witness, irrefutable_first_row_witness, the first-match, wildcard and variable fixtures and the 3,000-program seed fuzz. Counterexample to the total form at the implemented quota: the frozen control matrix-work (a 13-column matrix whose first row is 13 _ with body On{}, accepted by the seed with On{}) exhausts the fixed 4096-visit quota (Exhausted check budget), because expansion splits on a constructor head in any row even when the first row is irrefutable (24,574 visits). The control's Exhausted is Knot's cost model applied to a seed-accepted program (a D4 resource limit, not an Invalid). So the total obligation holds only relative to sufficient work (a quota at least the expansion's visits) and stays undischargeable as stated until expansion selects an irrefutable first row without splitting, which changes the frozen control and needs coordinator review

Exhaustive matrix (D21): unproved general law that an exhaustive matrix lowers to a tree with no missing branch; witnessed by exhaustive_matrix_witness, the remainder helper laws, the multi, nested, rec-nested and empty fixtures and the 3,000-program seed fuzz

module_loading.legacy_commands: Existing single-file forms retain their diagnostics, limits and exit codes; parent-relative imports now report Unsupported parse import.
module_loading.bundle: Explicit frozen local directory standing in for BEND_LIB; no network or named-package resolution.
module_loading.identity: Lexically normalized filesystem path after a host query checks exact directory-entry spelling and no symlink components; ambiguous paths report Unsupported load path-identity. Entry and bundle roots are queried before normalization.
module_loading.namespaces: Local modules relative to entry directory; bundle modules relative to bundle root; aliases are file-local.
module_loading.declaration_order: Dependency-first ordered stream; all user definitions checked, including unused definitions; completed paths are loaded once and active back edges rejected.

base.pin: Runtime Bend SHA-256 over bounded ASCII input, before inventory construction.
base.registration: Book-global from first import event, with distinct type/function and constructor namespaces. Both bare and qualified user declarations, and the later Base inventory, reject same-category collisions.
base.slice: Transitive dependencies of every user declaration. Selected ordinary Base bodies are parsed/checked; the closed literal registry lowers four types and 39 operations with checked signatures and quantities.
base.trust_inventory: After combined checking: BasePin, Module, BaseChecked source bodies, BaseIntrinsic trusted lowerings, BaseUnchecked exact unselected complement. The three declaration inventories partition all 466 declarations.
base.unsupported: Reachable forms outside the supported source or closed intrinsic surface retain specific Unsupported reasons; unsafe/foreign declarations are rejected before registry lookup.

limits.base_slice: Finite dependency work bound derived from parser depth.

module_loading.proof_boundary: Path, scope, transition, selection and digest helper laws; not whole-graph confluence, SHA-256 refinement or compiler correctness.
module_loading.foreign_effects: Existing IO/file effects plus src/path-host.bend::inspect, a minimal native/Bun filesystem identity query. It observes component spelling and symlinks only; classification stays in Bend. No environment lookup or network is added.
module_loading.wasm_profile: Default enum emitter; importing a book adds no fielded or recursive capability to it. Loader-installed primitive types select knot-literals-wasm-1, documented below.
module_loading.literals_amendment: tests/compiler-modules/SPEC.md#literals-amendment: registry lowering in base-load, BaseIntrinsic audit rows, literal-aware module lexing, raised --bundle defaults; approved by the coordinator, 2026-09-28, with the modules-owner sign-off granted.

literals.reader: ASCII source; decimal U32/Nat; quoted code lists; 1-8 digit Unicode escapes preserve arbitrary U32 codes including surrogates and NUL.
literals.patterns: Stable first-match primitive matrix; numeric/Char default required; Nat and String constructor expansion; every leaf checked, each path's first leaf before any other, and a failing leaf that its path does not select is Unsupported dead-arm, since the seed never checks it; Nat offsets 0..256, with `+` adjacent to the literal; `0n+t` reads as t, as in the seed. With Base, a literal or Nat offset arm on a datatype scrutinee is Invalid pattern-type; without it, the arm takes the literal-base-type rule.
literals.checking: Literals and Nat offsets check against a known type, as in the seed: an unannotated binding is Invalid annotation-required, and a literal or Nat offset scrutinee is Invalid constructor-scrutinee. An expression offset kn+t checks its tail once and wraps k = U32.to_nat(count) Succ constructors around it (src/literal-offset.bend::successors), the matrix spelling as in the seed; a successor takes no checker level. A count above 4096 is Exhausted check. See expression_offset for the compile limit and the laws.

intrinsic_registry.trust: Pinned semantics, independent finite differential checks and helper laws; no all-input Base refinement proof.

unsupported: operator sugar, including a `+` separated from a Nat literal
the Base U32 constructor U32{data: Word(32n)}, in patterns and expressions
a literal or Nat offset inside a constructor field pattern
general nested patterns beyond the bounded primitive matrix
a failing body in a matrix leaf that its path does not select (dead-arm)
without Base, a literal or Nat offset whose target datatype declares the constructor that spells it, or a U32 or Char literal with any target (literal-base-type)
core: Intrinsic with typed primitive opcode and checked arguments

representation.Char: unboxed i32 code, no surrogate merging
representation.String: SNil/SCon cells with unboxed Char head
representation.other_data: tag plus live fields in declaration order

wasm.exports: all source functions; runtime helpers, memory and globals unexported
wasm.lifetime: instance; immutable initialized cells; monotonic allocation; no reclamation
wasm.section_runs: Each section body enters the published builder as runs of at most 4096 bytes; the builder's finish copies a chunk with a non-tail List.append, so the run width bounds that host stack depth and both compiler lanes build identical modules up to max_instructions.
wasm.host_boundary: Enum-only live parameter/result signatures; valid declared ordinals and compiler provenance are caller preconditions.

literals.result_display: eval prints Evaluated<TAB>type<TAB>word<TAB>display. An installed primitive displays as the seed's literal (300, 3n, 'a', "a\n"), also inside records; other data displays Name{live fields} with ',' separators. The word is a U32 or Char value's bits, otherwise the constructor tag. The inspection budget and 65,536-character cap apply.
literals.abi_deviation: 64 MiB heap/stacks and an explicit instruction machine support frozen unary 65536n and deep non-tail self-recursion without a binary Nat representation or host-stack dependence.
literals.proof_boundary: Arithmetic guards, reader cases, literal display round trips, section runs, core transitions, offset construction (for every k, and every count up to 4096 in the checker laws) and pattern expansion; no whole-compiler, all-input intrinsic or memory refinement proof.

expression_offset.lowering: The tail is checked once and k = U32.to_nat(count) Succ constructors wrap it (src/literal-offset.bend::successors), keeping the tail's uses; the outermost takes the expected type.
expression_offset.count_limit_outcome: Exhausted check at the offset; the seed answers Yes
expression_offset.compile_limit: 2047 successors: the emitter takes two of its 4096 levels for each, so above that compilation is Exhausted emit and the checker CLI's core display is Exhausted inspect; evaluation continues to the count limit. Resource bounds, never rejections.
proved: src/literal-core-LAWS.bend::offset_cells: for every k, in any book, and every tail with a known value, k successors return k cells around it in 4k+c transitions (induction on k)
src/literal-core-LAWS.bend::offset_cells_call: offset_cells applied to a tail that calls a book function (k = 2, c = 3, 11 transitions)

src/check-LAWS.bend::offset_lowering: for every count up to 4096 and every tail that checks to a term and its uses, against the installed Nat, the checker returns successors(to_nat(count), term) with those uses
src/check-LAWS.bend::offset_bound: the same tails above 4096, Exhausted check
src/check-LAWS.bend::single_argument_keeps_uses: a constructor of one argument keeps its uses
expression_offset.trusted: U32.to_nat as Base's reading of the count; the linear allocation of recursion through an offset is measured by the frozen depth books, not proved

names_and_binders.names: A name is words joined by single dots, each a letter or underscore then letters, digits or underscores, as in the seed. A token that starts like a name and is not one is Invalid parse name, in every position; the parser reads names before structure (src/parse.bend::names).
names_and_binders.dotted_binder: A dotted pattern or let binder is Invalid parse pattern-binder (binding-name for a let) unless a parameter of the same function binds that exact name (src/parse.bend::binders); single-file and bundle entries alike.
names_and_binders.constructor_let_binder: A let binder naming a constructor of Base, of an import or of the book's own earlier declarations is Invalid check constructor-pattern-binder; a constructor declared later, a parameter, a function or a type may be named (src/qualify.bend::walk_in, --bundle only).
names_and_binders.offset_layout: The tail of an offset follows its `+` after a space, a newline, a comment or a blank line; a keyword on a later line is Unsupported parse term-form.
known_imprecisions: the single-file entry does not test let binders against constructors
a pattern binder named like a constructor declared later in the book is Invalid check constructor-pattern-binder, where the seed accepts it
an arm body starting left of its case keyword is Invalid parse body-indentation, where the seed accepts it
a newline after case or inside call or constructor arguments, other than after an offset's `+`, is Invalid parse expected-term, where the seed accepts it

unmet: primitive/structured Wasm host observations and host arguments
literals.style: Offline preflight only; live review and ratings belong to coordinator.
